mapper.select: SELECT ma.author_id, mu.nickname AS authorName FROM member_attention ma LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, nickname FROM member_user ) mu ON ma.author_id = mu.id WHERE ma.status = 0 AND ma.user_id = #{userId} AND ma.author_id NOT IN ( SELECT author_id FROM black_list bl WHERE bl.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.status = 1 ) ORDER BY ma.create_time DESC

SELECT map.author_id AS authorId, map.type AS type, CASE WHEN map.type = 1 THEN map.num WHEN map.type = 0 AND DATEDIFF(map.end_date, NOW()) > 0 THEN DATEDIFF(map.end_date, NOW()) WHEN map.type = 0 AND map.activate = 0 THEN map.num ELSE 0 END AS lastNum FROM ( SELECT mp.user_id, mp.author_id, mp.end_date, mp.num, mp.type, mp.activate, mp.status FROM member_author_privilege mp WHERE mp.user_id = #{reqVO.userId} ) map WHERE map.status = 1 AND map.author_id = #{reqVO.authorId} AND ( CASE WHEN map.type = 1 THEN map.num WHEN map.type = 0 AND DATEDIFF(map.end_date, NOW()) > 0 THEN DATEDIFF(map.end_date, NOW()) WHEN map.type = 0 AND map.activate = 0 THEN map.num ELSE 0 END ) > 0
